content: Service Name Ecu M_ Sleep Activity Syntax void Ecu M_ Sleep Activity ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x41 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This callout is invoked periodically in all reduced clock sleep modes. It is explicitely allowed to poll wakeup sources from this callout and to call wakeup notification functions to indicate the end of the sleep state to the ECU State Manager. Available via Ecu M_ Externals.h
